name: Tex-Mex Black Bean Salad with Tomato, Corn, Bell Pepper & Feta
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
